sentences.text: Paras @ Ankur vs State Of U.P. And Another on 6 May, 2025

Author: Vivek Varma
Bench: Vivek Varma
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc:72742
Court No. - 69
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 9508 of 2024
Applicant :- Paras @ Ankur

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Vidhu Bhooshan Shukla,Vivek Kumar Mishra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Manoj Kumar Tripathi,Mayuri Mehrotra,Shubhanjali Gupt
Hon'ble Vivek Varma,J.
1.

The present application has been filed with the prayer to grant anticipatory bail to the applicant in
Case Crime No. 291 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 323, 324, 313, 506 I.P.C., and Section 3/4 D.P.
Act, Police Station Najibabad, District- Bijnor.

2. After arguing the matter at some length, Sri Vidhu Bhooshan, counsel for the applicant prays for
withdrawal of the present bail application with liberty to the applicant to file regular bail application
before the Court of competent jurisdiction.

3.  In view of the above, this application is disposed of as withdrawn with liberty to the applicant to surrender before the concerned court and file regular bail application, which shall be decided in the light of decision rendered in Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another,
